mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as capital costs fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < -0.01 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) from prior month indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to revenue contraction.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST decline from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when GDPC1 and HOUST both decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings growth stalls.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when PAYEMS declines in high-unemployment regime, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over prior 3 months signals improving labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to output and margin pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >45% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < -0.01 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) from prior month indicates stagflationary pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days via margin squeeze.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL rise from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth demand regimes (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annually), RSAFS rising above 12-month average signals accelerating consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when RSAFS > 12-month average in high-growth demand regime, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
